subject: Social Media
title: What Viral Really Means
description: A quick win: understand What Viral Really Means.

hook.text: A cat video hits 50 million views. A health alert reaches billions. Both called 'viral.' Not the same.

buildup.text: True virality means exponential spread—each sharer reaches many, who each reach many more.

discovery.text: Most 'viral' content is actually broadcast—pushed by algorithms to millions from one source.

twist.text: A celebrity's post reaching ten million isn't viral. It's broadcasting. Viral needs chains of strangers.

climax.text: True viral content spreads without platform help. Remove the algorithm and it still moves.

punchline.text: Viral means the audience built itself.

quiz.question: What distinguishes truly viral content from broadcast content?
options: Exponential spread through chains of strangers
